I am an artist, creative coach, former art teacher and cultural worker in the public sector. Throughout the years, I have worked with many different expressions and materials – from wood and textile to clay, metal and other unexpected combinations.
For me, nature and the outdoors are like a magical space where time and imagination meet. Here, ideas can take shape, thoughts can be cleared, and the creative process can breathe on its own.

In coaching, playful curiosity and hands-on guidance meet. Whether you are looking for artistic immersion, new inspiration or a safe place for the creative process, I am here as a conversation partner, mentor and cheerleader.

Do you have an idea that you want to bring to life, but don't know how to start? Here you'll get support throughout the entire process: from artistic guidance to practical advice on materials and techniques.

My experience is that most people need at least three sessions to feel confident in the process and get an accurate picture of what the coaching can offer.
We explore your current situation, your aspirations, and how I can support you further. You will receive help in formulating goals and, already at this stage, tools to get started.
After each session you will receive a summary and inspiring homework assignments – practical, creative or reflective.
We end every conversation with a plan for what you want to focus on. All material is sent to you as a personal tool to return to.
Every conversation is fully customized to you - where you are in life and in your creative endeavors.
